verdict.rationale: The patent filing guidance states the credential requirement up front: "You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up." The same page publishes a documented email/post fallback, so the account wall is disclosed before the flow begins. The trade mark path only says you can apply online or by post, with no stated account or credential prerequisites, and nothing describes what identity proofing One Login itself involves. Missing for 10: the specific identity-proofing steps behind One Login (documents, verification checks), equivalent pre-start account and credential disclosure for trade mark filing, and hands-on corroboration that no extra steps appear mid-flow.
